'''Linat-an''', also known as '''nilat-an''', is a traditional [[pork]] [[stew]] from the [[Visayas]] and [[Mindanao]] islands of the [[Philippines]]. Linat-an characteristically uses [[pork ribs]] (or other bony [[cuts of pork]]) boiled and [[simmering|simmered]] until very tender, [[lemongrass]] ({{lang|ceb|tanglad}}), [[string beans]], and starchy ingredients for a thicker soup (usually [[taro]]). Like the very similar ''[[nilagang baboy]]'', the rest of its ingredients can vary, but they typically include [[chayote]], [[water spinach]], [[onion]], [[garlic]], [[pechay]], [[calabaza]], and [[bell pepper]]s. It is seasoned with salt, ground [[black pepper]], and [[fish sauce]] to taste.<ref name="hh">{{cite web |title=Filipino Pork Stew with Mixed Vegetables (Linat-Ang Baboy) Recipe |url=https://www.hungryhuy.com/filipino-pork-stew-with-mixed-vegetables-linat-ang-baboy-recipe/ |website=Hungry Huy |date=November 8, 2012 |access-date=December 30, 2021}}</ref><ref name="pp">{{cite web |title=Linat an Recipe (Boiled Pork Soup with Lemongrass) |url=https://panlasangpinoy.com/linat-an-recipe/ |website=Panlasang Pinoy |date=February 10, 2014 |access-date=December 30, 2021}}</ref><ref name="as">{{cite web |title=Linat-an |url=https://www.angsarap.net/2016/04/15/linat-an/ |website=Ang Sarap |date=April 15, 2016 |access-date=December 30, 2021}}</ref><ref name="mg">{{cite web |title=Linat-ang Baboy of Cebu |url=https://www.mamasguiderecipes.com/2020/01/07/linat-ang-baboy-of-cebu/ |website=Mama's Guide Recipes |date=January 7, 2020 |access-date=December 30, 2021}}</ref>

The name "linat-an" literally means "boiled until very tender". It can also be used generally to refer to other types of stews, including those made with beef or chicken.<ref name="Wolff">{{cite book |last1=Wolff |first1=John U. |title=A Dictionary of Cebuano Visayan, Volume II (L-Y) |date=1972 |publisher=Cornell University, Southeast Asia Program & The Linguistic Society of the Philippines |url=https://ecommons.cornell.edu/bitstream/handle/1813/11777/Cebuano_Visayan_IIopt.pdf?sequence=1}}</ref>
